  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ) el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
  [[ AND (
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]
 [[and ((
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
  [[ AND r.consigner_region IN ({{consigner_region}}) ]]
  [[ AND (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END) IN ({{platform}}) ]]
  [[ AND ev.app_version_num >= {{Version}} ]]
  [[ AND ev.upgrade_flag = {{Upgrade_flag}} ]]
 )
 SELECT interval,
  split_part,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN searched = 1 THEN user_code END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_code), 0) AS "% Home to 15. Book Clicked"
 FROM final
 WHERE split_part <> 'OTHER'
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2
 LIMIT 280

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Product Funnel > card 51326
 
 Aliases: home to book success %; landing-to-booking (app events).
 
 Share of PTL home-page users in the interval who also fired step 16 (Book Success) and every earlier step 02..15 in the same interval; steps are cumulative.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1 and MAX(step 02 flag) x ... x MAX(step 16 flag) = 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1), 0), per interval x split.
 Steps the user must fire (all within the same interval part; order and session are not checked):
 01. Home Page (base, landed_flag): any event with screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%'.
 02. Lane Entered: screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input', OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on screen ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input.
 03. Price Check Requested: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input with COALESCE(miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%' (payload st: = rate-API request), OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on any PTL screen.
 04. Rates Shown: event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') on any PTL screen.
 05. Package Details: v1_ptl_package_details on ptl_package_details_input (payload carries pcid, so it follows the price check).
 06. Package Details Submitted: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_package_details_input (payload wt / uom / lbhq: weight, LBH, quantity).
 07. Transporter Selected: v1_ptl_select_transporter on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg (a transporter card tap).
 08. Create Pickup / Pickup Slot: v1_ptl_pickup_slot / v1_ptl_pickup_slot_view / v1_ptl_slot_select on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg, OR v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter with miscellaneous ILIKE '%tpt:%'.
 09. PTL Demand: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter with miscellaneous ILIKE '%tpt:%' (the Proceed / Book CTA where the app creates the demand), OR any event with non-blank demand_id on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_pickup_address / ptl_preview.
 10. Pickup Address: v1_ptl_pickup_detail on ptl_pickup_address.
 11. Pickup Submitted: v1_ptl_pickup_submit on ptl_pickup_address, OR any event on ptl_billing_gst / ptl_preview (reaching a later screen implies submit).
 12. Billing GST (or not required): any event on ptl_billing_gst, OR v1_ptl_booking_detail on ptl_preview (the GST screen is skipped when not required).
 13. Preview: v1_ptl_booking_detail on ptl_preview.
 14. Preview CTA: v1_ptl_preview_cta / v1_ptl_book / v1_view_insufficient_balance_modal on ptl_preview, OR v1_ptl_book_success on any PTL screen.
 15. Book Clicked: v1_ptl_book on ptl_preview, OR v1_ptl_book_success on any PTL screen.
 16. Book Success: v1_ptl_book_success on any PTL screen.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the global experiment phase (days on or after the first-ever allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45 across all users). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps a user's row only if the user is in that arm and the first event timestamp in the row is strictly after the user's own allocation timestamp for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. Output: interval, split_part and the value, ordered by interval descending, limit 280 rows.
 Caveats: Steps are a set within the interval part, not time-ordered or session-bound, so each step count is a subset of the earlier steps' counts. Numerator and denominator both apply every filter and the split, and both require landed_flag = 1. App and consigner web only; web portal users (blank user_code) are not counted. Booking-flow events start around 22 May 2026, so earlier months read 0. This is the app book-success event; for backend bookings use fact_ptl_bookings (placement_flag = 1).
SQL:
-- PTL Product Funnel (clickstream fact_cx_events_l12m). Base = users who landed on ptl_home_page in the interval.
 -- Step 16 (CUMULATIVE): user must reach stages 02..16 in the same interval -> funnel can never increase
 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_start AS (
  -- Live start of each experiment = first allocation timestamp of its arms
  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp2_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS browsing_start
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),
 exp_time AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(created)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_package_details') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_select_transporter') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_pickup_slot','v1_ptl_pickup_slot_view','v1_ptl_slot_select')) OR (a.screen_name = 'ptl_select_transporter' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND a.miscellaneous ILIKE '%tpt:%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name = 'ptl_select_transporter' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND a.miscellaneous ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_pickup_address','ptl_preview') AND NULLIF(a.demand_id,'') IS NOT NULL)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pickup_address' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_pickup_detail') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name = 'ptl_pickup_address' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_pickup_submit') OR a.screen_name IN ('ptl_billing_gst','ptl_preview')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_billing_gst' OR (a.screen_name = 'ptl_preview' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_booking_detail')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_preview' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_booking_detail') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name = 'ptl_preview' AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_preview_cta','v1_ptl_book','v1_view_insufficient_balance_modal')) OR a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_book_success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name = 'ptl_preview' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_book') OR a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_book_success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_book_success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END END),
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END)) AS app_version_num
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m a
  LEFT JOIN exp_time t ON t.user_code = a.user_code
  CROSS JOIN exp_start s
  WHERE a.event_date::date <= current_date
  AND a.screen_name LIKE 'ptl%' -- PTL screens only (perf)
  AND a.event_date::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] CASE
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' THEN current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' THEN current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' THEN current_date - interval '12 months'
  ELSE current_date - interval '14 days' END)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 ),
 seg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 1 THEN demand_time END) AS first_trip_time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 3 THEN demand_time END) AS third_trip_time

 exp AS (
  SELECT user_code,

  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp_lbl AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
 ),
 reg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code, MAX(consigner_region) AS consigner_region
  FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 final AS (
  SELECT ev.interval,
  CASE {{split}}
  WHEN 'Cx Segment PTL' THEN (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp_lbl el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
  [[ AND (
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]
 [[and ((
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1)
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
  [[ AND r.consigner_region IN ({{consigner_region}}) ]]
  [[ AND (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END) IN ({{platform}}) ]]
  [[ AND ev.app_version_num >= {{Version}} ]]
  [[ AND ev.upgrade_flag = {{Upgrade_flag}} ]]
 )
 SELECT interval,
  split_part,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN searched = 1 THEN user_code END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_code), 0) AS "% Home to 16. Book Success"
 FROM final
 WHERE split_part <> 'OTHER'
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2
 LIMIT 280

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Cx Experience > card 51602
 
 Aliases: Rating funnel base; # Delivered trips; # Trips ended.
 
 Number of delivered PTL trips (trip_end_time not null) since the rating feature went live.
 Formula: trips_ended = count(distinct demand_id) where trip_end_time is not null and trip_end_time >= 2026-06-15. The query also returns the came-back, rating-page, rated and bad-rated columns; this card plots trips_ended.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings LEFT JOIN fact_consigner_service_stats (business_type = 'PTL', rating > 0) on demand_id; fact_cx_events_l12m for the consignor's latest ptl_home_page and v1_ptl_rating_page events (epoch micros, UTC; compared directly with trip_end_time); dated on trip_end_time (IST), from 2026-06-15; grain demand (delivered PTL trip, trip_end_time not null).
 Filters: Split (required): Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, live allocations only (deleted = 'false'): 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status (demand_time after the consignor's first browsing-experiment allocation). Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible).
 Caveats: the base excludes trips that ended before 2026-06-15. A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.
SQL:
Select 
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', trip_end_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', trip_end_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', trip_end_time) else current_date::timestamp end) as interval,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (Case when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (Case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when c.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)
  else 'Overall'::varchar(100)
  end as split_part,
  count(distinct a.demand_id) as trips_ended,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end) as came_back,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and rp.last_rp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end) as rating_page_viewed,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end) as rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 and b.rating < 4 then a.demand_id end) as bad_rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct a.demand_id),0) as pct_came_back,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and rp.last_rp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_rating_page_viewed,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 and b.rating < 4 then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_bad_rated,
  avg(case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then b.rating::float end) as avg_rating
 
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 left join mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_service_stats as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id and b.business_type = 'PTL' and b.rating > 0
 
 -- customer came back to ptl_home_page after the trip ended
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') as last_hp_time
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m
 WHERE screen_name ilike '%ptl_home_page%'
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as hp on hp.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 -- customer viewed the PTL rating page (v1_ptl_rating_page) after the trip ended
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') as last_rp_time
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m
 WHERE event_name = 'v1_ptl_rating_page'

 ) as rp on rp.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as test1,
  max(case when variant_id = 18 then 1 else 0 end) as control1,
  max(case when variant_id = 36 then 1 else 0 end) as control2,
  max(case when variant_id = 37 then 1 else 0 end) as test2,
  max(case when variant_id = 44 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_control,
  max(case when variant_id = 45 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_test,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (17,18) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as exp1_live_ist,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (36,37) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as exp2_live_ist,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (44,45) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as c on c.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  case variant_id
  when 17 then 'Test1 - 17'
  when 18 then 'Control1 - 18'
  when 36 then 'Control2 - 36'
  when 37 then 'Test2 - 37'
  when 44 then 'Browsing Control - 44'

  end as exp_label
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ) as el
  on el.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
  and {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[and el.exp_label in ({{exp_type}})]]
 [[and (el.exp_label in ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT consigner_user_code, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region
 FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as r on r.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Cx Experience > card 51603
 
 Aliases: # Came back after trip; Post-trip revisits.
 
 Number of delivered PTL trips whose consignor visited the PTL home page after the trip ended.
 Formula: came_back = count(distinct demand_id) where the consignor came back. came_back = the consignor's latest event on a screen like '%ptl_home_page%' in fact_cx_events_l12m is later than trip_end_time. This card plots came_back.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings LEFT JOIN fact_consigner_service_stats (business_type = 'PTL', rating > 0) on demand_id; fact_cx_events_l12m for the consignor's latest ptl_home_page and v1_ptl_rating_page events (epoch micros, UTC; compared directly with trip_end_time); dated on trip_end_time (IST), from 2026-06-15; grain demand (delivered PTL trip, trip_end_time not null).
 Filters: Split (required): Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, all allocation rows, including deleted ones: 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status (demand_time after the consignor's first browsing-experiment allocation). Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible).
 Caveats: not 'came back within N days of the trip'; came_back uses the consignor's latest PTL home-page visit, not a fixed post-trip window, so older trips have had longer to qualify; effectively app-only (web portal users have a blank user_code). A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.

  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', trip_end_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', trip_end_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', trip_end_time) else current_date::timestamp end) as interval,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (Case when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (Case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when c.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)

  count(distinct a.demand_id) as trips_ended,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end) as came_back,

  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end) as rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 and b.rating < 4 then a.demand_id end) as bad_rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct a.demand_id),0) as pct_came_back,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and rp.last_rp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_rating_page_viewed,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_rated,
  count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 and b.rating < 4 then a.demand_id end)*100.0/nullif(count(distinct case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then a.demand_id end),0) as pct_bad_rated,
  avg(case when hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time and b.rating > 0 then b.rating::float end) as avg_rating

 Share of delivered PTL trips whose consignor visited the PTL home page after the trip ended.

 Aliases: Rating page view rate.
 
 Of delivered PTL trips whose consignor came back, the share where the consignor viewed the rating page after the trip.

This card plots pct_rating_page_viewed.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings LEFT JOIN fact_consigner_service_stats (business_type = 'PTL', rating > 0) on demand_id; fact_cx_events_l12m for the consignor's latest ptl_home_page and v1_ptl_rating_page events (epoch micros, UTC; compared directly with trip_end_time); dated on trip_end_time (IST), from 2026-06-15; grain demand (delivered PTL trip, trip_end_time not null).
 Filters: Split (required): Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, all allocation rows, including deleted ones: 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status (demand_time after the consignor's first browsing-experiment allocation). Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible).

 Filters: Split (required): Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, all allocation rows, including deleted ones: 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status (demand_time after the consignor's first browsing-experiment allocation). Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible).

Monthly counts are small. came_back uses the consignor's latest PTL home-page visit, not a fixed post-trip window, so older trips have had longer to qualify; effectively app-only (web portal users have a blank user_code).  Aliases: Bad rating reasons trend; Delivery-delay share of bad ratings.
 
 Per period, the share of bad-rated PTL trips (rating 1-3) tagged with each reason.
 Formula: pct_of_bad_rated = count(distinct demand_id with reason R) / count(distinct bad-rated demand_id) in the same interval x split. reasons is a JSON array exploded to up to 8 elements, so one trip can count under several reasons and shares can sum to more than 100%. Labels: DELIVERY_DELAY = 'Issues with Delivery', PICKUP_DELAY = 'Issues in Pick-Up', DAMAGED_GOODS = 'Damaged Goods'; other values shown raw; null or empty = 'No reason selected'.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_service_stats (business_type = 'PTL', 0 < rating < 4) joined to fact_ptl_bookings; dated on trip_end_time (IST), from 2026-06-15; grain demand x reason.
 Filters: split (required), Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row), segment, Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3), exp, Source, platform, version, weight, advance.

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Cx Experience > card 51653
 
 Aliases: Bad rating reasons; Reason mix; Top complaints.
 
 Pooled (not time-series) share of bad-rated PTL trips (rating 1-3) tagged with each reason over the selected window; the interval column is fixed to current_date, so all periods in the window are pooled into one row per split x reason.
 Formula: pct_of_bad_rated = count(distinct demand_id with reason R) * 100.0 / count(distinct bad-rated demand_id) in the same split. reasons is a JSON array exploded to up to 8 elements, so one trip can count under several reasons and shares can sum to more than 100%. Labels: DELIVERY_DELAY = 'Issues with Delivery', PICKUP_DELAY = 'Issues in Pick-Up', DAMAGED_GOODS = 'Damaged Goods'; other values shown raw; null, invalid or empty array = 'No reason selected'. Series = reason (Overall) or split | reason.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_service_stats (business_type = 'PTL', 0 < rating < 4) INNER JOIN fact_ptl_bookings on demand_id; fact_cx_events_l12m for the came-back gate; window on trip_end_time (IST), from 2026-06-15; grain demand x reason.
 Filters: Split (required): Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id: 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status. Interval sets the window only (14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline, consigner_region, Source, platform, version, Upgrade_flag, weight, advance_flag.
 Caveats: only trips whose consignor came back are included (the consignor's latest ptl_home_page event in fact_cx_events_l12m is later than trip_end_time), so bad ratings on other trips are excluded; effectively app-only. Small bases. A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.
SQL:
with n as (
  select 0 as i union all select 1 union all select 2 union all select 3
  union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7
 ),
 base as (
 Select
  current_date::timestamp as interval,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (Case when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (Case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when c.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)
  else 'Overall'::varchar(100)
  end as split_part,
  a.demand_id as demand_id,
  b.reasons as reasons
 
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 join mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_service_stats as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id and b.business_type = 'PTL' and b.rating > 0 and b.rating < 4
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') as last_hp_time
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m
 WHERE screen_name ilike '%ptl_home_page%'
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as hp on hp.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as test1,
  max(case when variant_id = 18 then 1 else 0 end) as control1,
  max(case when variant_id = 36 then 1 else 0 end) as control2,
  max(case when variant_id = 37 then 1 else 0 end) as test2,
  max(case when variant_id = 44 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_control,
  max(case when variant_id = 45 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_test,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (44,45) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as c on c.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  case variant_id
  when 17 then 'Test1 - 17'
  when 18 then 'Control1 - 18'
  when 36 then 'Control2 - 36'
  when 37 then 'Test2 - 37'
  when 44 then 'Browsing Control - 44'
  when 45 then 'Browsing Test - 45'
  end as exp_label
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ) as el
  on el.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
  and {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[and el.exp_label in ({{exp_type}})]]
 [[and (el.exp_label in ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT consigner_user_code, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region
 FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as r on r.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = a.consigner_user_code
 
 where
  trip_end_time::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] case
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' then current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' then current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' then current_date - interval '12 months'
  else current_date - interval '14 days'
  end)
  and trip_end_time>0
  and a.trip_end_time >= '2026-06-15' -- rating feature live date
  and trip_end_time::date>='2026-05-01'
  and hp.last_hp_time > a.trip_end_time
 [[
 and (case when ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New'
 when ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)
 in ({{cx_segment_ptl}})
 ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
 
 [[and (
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
 )]]
 [[and ((
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
 )) is not true]]
 [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm is paired with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and (Case
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1)
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and (Case
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1)
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})
 ]]
 [[and (case when source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP'
 when source IS NULL AND app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP'
 when source is not null then source
 else 'NA' end) in ({{Source}})]]
 [[and (Case when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android'
 when app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end) in ({{platform}})]]
 [[and app_version >= {{version}}]]
 [[and (Case
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = {{Upgrade_flag}}
 ]]
 [[and (case when coalesce(a.chargeable_weight::float, 0) < 300 then '0-300' else '300+' end) in ({{weight}})]]
 [[and a.advance_eligible = {{advance_flag}}]]
 ),
 
 den as (
  select interval, split_part, count(distinct demand_id) as bad_rated
  from base group by 1,2
 ),
 
 ex as (
  select base.interval, base.split_part, base.demand_id,
  (case json_extract_array_element_text(base.reasons, n.i, true)
  when 'DAMAGED_GOODS' then 'Damaged Goods'
  when 'DELIVERY_DELAY' then 'Issues with Delivery'
  when 'PICKUP_DELAY' then 'Issues in Pick-Up'
  else json_extract_array_element_text(base.reasons, n.i, true)
  end)::varchar(100) as reason
  from base join n on n.i < json_array_length(base.reasons, true)
  where is_valid_json_array(base.reasons)
 
  union all
 
  select base.interval, base.split_part, base.demand_id,
  'No reason selected'::varchar(100) as reason
  from base
  where base.reasons is null
  or is_valid_json_array(base.reasons) is not true
  or json_array_length(base.reasons, true) = 0
 )
 
 select
  (case when e.split_part = 'Overall' then e.reason else e.split_part || ' | ' || e.reason end)::varchar(200) as series,
  e.split_part,
  e.reason,
  count(distinct e.demand_id) as bad_rated_trips,
  d.bad_rated as total_bad_rated_trips,
  count(distinct e.demand_id) * 100.0 / nullif(d.bad_rated, 0) as pct_of_bad_rated
 from ex e
 join den d on d.interval = e.interval and d.split_part = e.split_part
 group by 1,2,3, d.bad_rated
 order by 6 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Consigner Payment > card 51589
 
 Aliases: % Recovery within due date; On-time collection %; % Recovery D0.
 
 Share of PTL trip receivables collected by the due date.
 Formula: recovery_with_due_date = sum(-1 * recovered_within_due_date) * 100 / sum(receivable); receivable = coalesce(nullif(fact_ptl_bookings.receivable_amount, 0), as_trip_payments.receivable_before_settlement). Recovered amounts are stored negative in as_trip_payments, hence the -1 multiplier. The query also returns D+N recovery and NPA columns; this card plots recovery_with_due_date.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments (ptl_flag = 1, one row per demand) INNER JOIN fact_ptl_bookings (trip_flag = 1) on demand_id; dated on due_date (calendar date, <= current_date); grain demand.
 Filters: Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row), bucketed on due_date. Split: Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, live allocations only (deleted = 'false'): 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status. Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, advance_flag (advance_eligible), weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg).
 Caveats: recovered amounts can exceed the receivable for individual demands (overpayments later refunded), so small cuts can read above 100%. The latest bucket is partial. A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.
SQL:
Select 
 (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.due_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.due_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.due_date) else current_date::timestamp end)::Date as month,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (Case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (Case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when a.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > a.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)
  else 'Overall'::varchar(100)
  end as split_part,
 sum(-1*recovered_within_due_date)*100/nullif(sum(coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement)),0) as recovery_with_due_date,
 sum(case when days_since_due>=3 then -1*recovered_within_3_days else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=3 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as recovery_with_due_date3,
 
 sum(case when days_since_due>=7 then -1*recovered_within_7_days else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=7 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as recovery_with_due_date7,
 sum(case when days_since_due>=15 then -1*recovered_within_15_days else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=15 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as recovery_with_due_date15,
 sum(case when days_since_due>=30 then -1*recovered_within_30_days else null end)*100
 
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=30 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as recovery_with_due_date30,
 
 sum(case when days_since_due>=60 then -1*recovered_within_60_days else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=60 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as recovery_with_due_date60,
 
 sum(case when days_since_due>=90 then demand_gross_npa else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=90 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as gross_npa,
 
 sum(case when days_since_due>=180 then demand_net_npa else null end)*100
 /nullif(sum(case when days_since_due>=180 then coalesce(nullif(pb.receivable_amount,0), a.receivable_before_settlement) else null end),0) as net_npa
 
 from (WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_live_ist,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_test_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000
  * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_live_ist
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 )
 
 Select a.*,
 advance_eligible AS advance_flag,
 (case when source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP' 
 when source IS NULL AND app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP' 
 when source is not null then source
 else 'NA' end) as source_bucket,
 app_platform,app_version,
 c.browsing_live_ist,
 c.test1_enrolled_at, c.control1_enrolled_at, c.control2_enrolled_at, c.test2_enrolled_at,
 c.browsing_control_enrolled_at, c.browsing_test_enrolled_at
 
 
 
 from mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments as a
 join mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as pb on pb.demand_id = a.demand_id
 left join c on c.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 where pb.trip_flag = 1 and ptl_flag = 1) as a
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as test1,
  max(case when variant_id = 18 then 1 else 0 end) as control1,
  max(case when variant_id = 36 then 1 else 0 end) as control2,

 Aliases: Recovery within 3 days of due date; % Recovery D+3.
 
 Share of matured PTL trip receivables collected within 3 days of the due date.
 Formula: recovery_with_due_date3 = sum(-1 * recovered_within_3_days where days_since_due >= 3) * 100 / sum(receivable where days_since_due >= 3); receivable = coalesce(nullif(fact_ptl_bookings.receivable_amount, 0), as_trip_payments.receivable_before_settlement). Numerator and denominator are both limited to receivables at least 3 days past due. Recovered amounts are stored negative in as_trip_payments, hence the -1 multiplier. This card plots recovery_with_due_date3.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments (ptl_flag = 1, one row per demand) INNER JOIN fact_ptl_bookings (trip_flag = 1) on demand_id; dated on due_date (calendar date, <= current_date); grain demand.
 Filters: Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row), bucketed on due_date. Split: Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, live allocations only (deleted = 'false'): 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), Browsing Live Status. Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, advance_flag (advance_eligible), weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg).
