 Share of delivered PTL trips with a billing GST number supplied that have an INVOICE document.
 Formula: count(distinct demand_id with an INVOICE row in fact_documents) * 100.0 / count(distinct demand_id), both over trips with billing_gst_flag = 1. Columns: trips, invoice_trips, % invoice.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (trip_end_time not null, vib_demand_state = 'COMPLETED', billing_gst_flag = 1) LEFT JOIN (select distinct demand_id from fact_documents where document_type = 'INVOICE'); dated on trip_end_time (IST), up to current_date; grain demand.
 Filters: Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row), bucketed on trip_end_time. Split: Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, live allocations only (deleted = 'false'): 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), To Pay (fact_ptl_bookings.topay_flag: To Pay / Paid), Browsing Live Status. Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, transporter_name (DELHIVERY / DP WORLD / SAFEXPRESS PVT LTD / BUSYBEES / ATC TPT, else OTHER), Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible), to_pay (fact_ptl_bookings.topay_flag).
 Caveats: billing_gst_flag is captured from about Aug 2026, so the card has data only from then. Invoices are generated after delivery, so the latest periods are immature and read low. A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.
SQL:
-- % Invoice Generated : share of PTL trips with an INVOICE document raised
 -- Base: fact_ptl_bookings, trip_flag = 1, trended on demand_time
 -- Invoice flag from fact_documents where document_type = 'INVOICE'
 -- Window capped at current_date - 2 to avoid invoice-generation lag
 
 with inv as (
  select distinct demand_id, 1 as invoice_flag
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_documents
  where document_type = 'INVOICE'
 )
 
 Select 
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.trip_end_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.trip_end_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.trip_end_time) else current_date::timestamp end)::date as date,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when a.ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when a.ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region,'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'To Pay' then (case when a.topay_flag = 1 then 'To Pay' else 'Paid' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when c.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)
  else 'Overall'::varchar(100)
  end as split_part,
 
  count(distinct a.demand_id) as trips,
  count(distinct case when coalesce(b.invoice_flag,0) = 1 then a.demand_id else null end) as invoice_trips,
  invoice_trips*100.0/nullif(trips,0) as "% invoice"
 
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 
 LEFT JOIN inv as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as test1,
  max(case when variant_id = 18 then 1 else 0 end) as control1,
  max(case when variant_id = 36 then 1 else 0 end) as control2,
  max(case when variant_id = 37 then 1 else 0 end) as test2,
  max(case when variant_id = 44 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_control,
  max(case when variant_id = 45 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_test,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (44,45) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=17 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=18 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=36 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=37 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=44 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=45 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_test_enrolled_at
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as c on c.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  case variant_id
  when 17 then 'Test1 - 17' when 18 then 'Control1 - 18'
  when 36 then 'Control2 - 36' when 37 then 'Test2 - 37'
  when 44 then 'Browsing Control - 44' when 45 then 'Browsing Test - 45'
  end as exp_label
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ) as el
  on el.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
  and {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[and el.exp_label in ({{exp_type}})]]
 [[and (el.exp_label in ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT consigner_user_code, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region
 FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as r on r.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = a.consigner_user_code
 where a.trip_end_time is not null and billing_gst_flag = 1
 and vib_demand_state = 'COMPLETED'
 and a.trip_end_time::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] case 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' then current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' then current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' then current_date - interval '12 months'
  else current_date - interval '14 days' 
 end)
 and a.trip_end_time::date <= current_date
 [[and (case when a.ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when a.ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ptl}})]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
 [[and (
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
 )]]
 [[and ((
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
 )) is not true]]
 [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1)
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 [[and (case when a.transporter_name in ('DELHIVERY','DP WORLD','SAFEXPRESS PVT LTD','BUSYBEES','ATC TPT') then a.transporter_name else 'OTHER' END) in ({{transporter_name}})]]
 [[and (case when a.source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when a.source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP' 
 when a.source IS NULL AND a.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP' 
 when a.source is not null then a.source
 else 'NA' end) in ({{Source}})]]
 [[and (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android'
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end) in ({{platform}})]]
 [[and a.app_version >= {{version}}]]
 [[and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = {{Upgrade_flag}}]]
 [[and (case when coalesce(a.chargeable_weight::float, 0) < 300 then '0-300' else '300+' end) in ({{weight}})]]
 [[and a.advance_eligible = {{advance_flag}}]]
 [[and a.topay_flag::varchar in ({{to_pay}})]]
 
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Consigner Payment > card 51744
 
 Aliases: A1 Payment Funnel; A1 payment-mode recovery.
 
 Funnel and recovery for app PTL demands on payment_submode 'A1'.
 Formula: plc = placed demands; advance_plc = advance_eligible = 1; a1_plc = payment_submode 'A1'; a1_pickup_done = A1 with in_transit_time; a1_trip = A1 with trip_flag = 1; due / due+3 / due+7 received % = sum(abs(recovered_within_X)) / sum(fact_ptl_bookings.receivable_amount) over A1 trips with days_since_due >= 0 / 3 / 7; till-date received % = abs(overall_received_amount) / receivable at days_since_due >= 0; % Trip with payment = A1 trips with recovered_within_due_date < 0 / a1_trip (integer division, whole-number %).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (placement_flag = 1; source APP or APP WEB only, so the PTL web portal is excluded) LEFT JOIN fact_demands (payment_submode) and as_trip_payments (one row per demand); dated on placement_time (IST); window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months.
 Filters: Interval only.
 Caveats: payment submode A1 exists from 9 Oct 2026; earlier rows are 0. A1 demands are not a subset of advance-eligible demands, so a1_plc can exceed advance_plc.
SQL:
select
 (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', placement_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', placement_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', placement_time) else current_date::timestamp end) as interval,
 
 count(distinct demand_id) as plc,
 count(distinct case when advance_eligible =1 then demand_id else null end) as advance_plc,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' then demand_id else null end) as a1_plc,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and in_transit_time is not null then demand_id else null end) as a1_pickup_done,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 then demand_id else null end) as a1_trip,
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then recovered_within_due_date else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 3 then recovered_within_3_days else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 3 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due+3 received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 7 then recovered_within_7_days else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 7 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due+7 received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then overall_received_amount else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "tilldate received%",
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and recovered_within_due_date<0 then demand_id else null end)*100/nullif(a1_trip,0) as "% Trip with payment"
 
 from
 (Select a.*,b.payment_submode,recovered_within_due_date,recovered_within_3_days,recovered_within_7_days,overall_received_amount,
 days_since_due
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 left join mp_analytics_core.fact_demands as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id
 left join mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments as c on c.demand_id = a.demand_id
 where placement_flag = 1
 AND (case when source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP' 
 when source IS NULL AND a.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP' 
 when source is not null then source
 else 'NA' end) IN ('APP WEB','APP')
 
 
 -- and cx_segments_ptl = '1-3'
 -- cx_segments_ptl_prospective
 )
 
 Where 1=1
 and 
  placement_time::date >= coalesce(case 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' then current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' then current_date - interval '14 weeks' 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' then current_date - interval '12 months'
  else current_date - interval '14 days' 
  end)
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL-live consignors; SHOW_PTL base; PTL exposed Cx.
 
 Number of consignors for whom PTL is live in the app (cross-sell test arm), by the month PTL went live for them.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code) from fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 (SHOW_PTL) and deleted = false; dated on the first live allocation time (min(created), epoch microseconds).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation; grain consignor; cohort = live month.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: deleted = false means the allocation is live; deleted = true means PTL is not shown, so those rows are excluded. This is the denominator for every 'per PTL-live Cx' metric. Web portal and ODIN PTL customers are not gated by this flag, so many PTL customers are never in this base.
SQL:
with live as (
  -- PTL-live = SHOW_PTL (variant_id 17), live allocations only
  select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', l.live_time)::date as live_month,
  count(*) as "# PTL-live Cx"
 from live l
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 where 1=1
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: % PTL-live Cx with Requirement (D1 / D7 / D30)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL reach; PTL activation; Live -> Requirement %.
 
 Of consignors whose PTL went live in the month, the % who created at least one PTL requirement within 1, 7 and 30 days of going live. Also returns the % with a real PTL demand and the % acquired (first-ever PTL pickup) within 30 days.
 Formula: count(Cx with a first requirement_flag = 1 row in [live_time, live_time + N days)) / count(PTL-live Cx). The acquisition denominator excludes consignors who were already PTL customers before going live.
 Source: fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17, deleted = false = live), fact_ptl_requirements (requirement_flag = 1, price_check_time IST), fact_ptl_bookings (real demand_id; first pickup_done_time = PTL acquisition); cohort = live month; grain consignor.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: only cohorts live at least 30 days ago are shown (fixed 30-day window, so months are comparable). This is a reach metric for the SHOW_PTL arm, not a test-vs-control lift.
SQL:
with live as (
  -- PTL-live = SHOW_PTL (variant_id 17), live allocations only
  select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 req as (
  select l.user_code, min(q.price_check_time) as first_req
  from live l
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements q
  on q.consigner_user_code = l.user_code and q.requirement_flag = 1
  and q.price_check_time >= l.live_time and q.price_check_time < l.live_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 ),
 dem as (
  select l.user_code, min(b.demand_time) as first_demand
  from live l
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings b
  on b.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
  and b.demand_time >= l.live_time and b.demand_time < l.live_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 ),
 acq as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(pickup_done_time) as first_pickup
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', l.live_time)::date as live_month,
  count(*) as ptl_live_cx,
  sum(case when req.first_req < l.live_time + interval '1 day' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d1,
  sum(case when req.first_req < l.live_time + interval '7 days' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d7,
  count(req.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d30,
  count(dem.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_demand_d30,
  sum(case when a.first_pickup >= l.live_time and a.first_pickup < l.live_time + interval '30 days' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0
  / nullif(sum(case when a.first_pickup is null or a.first_pickup >= l.live_time then 1 else 0 end),0) as pct_acquired_d30
 from live l
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 left join req on req.user_code = l.user_code
 left join dem on dem.user_code = l.user_code
 left join acq a on a.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 where l.live_time::date <= current_date - 30
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: # PTL Acquisitions by Channel (+ % from FTL base)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL acquisitions; New PTL customers; FTL -> PTL conversions.
 
 Number of consignors whose first-ever PTL pickup happened in the month, split by the channel of that first shipment, and the % of them who were already FTL customers (first FTL trip before the first PTL pickup). Business acquisition number across all channels, not an experiment number.
 Formula: min(pickup_done_time) per consigner_user_code on fact_ptl_bookings; FTL base = dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl before the first PTL pickup date.
 Source: fact_ptl_bookings; dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl (first FTL trip, history from 2019, never filled for PTL-only consignors); dated on first pickup_done_time (IST); grain consignor.
 Rule: use acquisition_date_ftl for the first FTL trip. dim_consigners.first_trip_date covers any load type (for PTL-only consignors it holds their first PTL trip). dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ptl = demand date of the first PTL trip, not the pickup date.
 Channel: PTL WEB = source 'WEB PORTAL'; APP WEB = app_platform 'CONSIGNER_WEB'; APP = app source; ODIN = manual.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: new and existing PTL customers come through different channels; read split by channel. The latest month is partial.
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 first_pickup as (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time as first_pickup, source, app_platform
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time, source, app_platform,
  row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by pickup_done_time, demand_id) as rn
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  ) x
  where rn = 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', f.first_pickup)::date as acq_month,
  case when f.source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
  when f.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
  when f.source ilike 'APP%' or (f.source is null and f.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP')) then 'APP'
  else coalesce(f.source, 'NA') end as channel,
  count(*) as "# PTL Acquisitions",
  sum(case when dc.first_trip_date < f.first_pickup::date then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% from FTL base"
 from first_pickup f
 left join (
  -- FTL acquisition date (first FTL trip), history from 2019; FTL-only, no PTL leakage
  select consigner_user_code, min(acquisition_date_ftl) as first_trip_date
  from mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  group by 1
 ) dc
  on dc.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where f.first_pickup >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Cross-sell penetration; FTL -> PTL wallet share; Dual-use rate.
 
 Of consignors with at least one FTL trip in the month, the % who also had a PTL requirement in the same month, and the % who also shipped PTL (PTL pickup) in the same month.
 Formula: count(FTL-active Cx with requirement_flag = 1 in the month) / count(FTL-active Cx); same with pickup_done_time in the month.
 Source: fact_demands (load_type = 'FTL', trip_flag = 1, demand_time), fact_ptl_requirements (price_check_time IST), fact_ptl_bookings (pickup_done_time IST); grain consignor x month.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: same-month co-occurrence, not sequence. The latest month is partial. fact_demands starts Oct 2025.
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 ftl as (
  select date_trunc('month', demand_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
  where load_type = 'FTL' and trip_flag = 1 and demand_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '12 months'
  group by 1,2
 ),
 req as (
  select date_trunc('month', price_check_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements
  where requirement_flag = 1
  group by 1,2
 ),
 pick as (
  select date_trunc('month', pickup_done_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  group by 1,2
 )
 select f.m as month,
  count(*) as ftl_active_cx,
  count(q.consigner_user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% with PTL Requirement",
  count(p.consigner_user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% shipped PTL"
 from ftl f
 left join req q on q.m = f.m and q.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join pick p on p.m = f.m and p.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where 1=1
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL repeat rate; 2nd PTL shipment rate; PTL retention.
 
 Of consignors acquired on PTL in the month (first-ever PTL pickup), the % who had a second PTL pickup within 30 and 60 days of the first.
 Formula: count(Cx with 2nd pickup_done_time - 1st pickup_done_time <= N days) / count(acquired Cx), N = 30, 60.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (pickup_done_time IST); cohort = month of first pickup; grain consignor.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: only cohorts whose first pickup is at least 60 days old are shown (fixed window). Repeat behaviour differs strongly by the channel of the first shipment (web portal vs app).
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 p as (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time,
  row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by pickup_done_time, demand_id) as rn
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
 ),
 f as (
  select a.consigner_user_code, a.pickup_done_time as first_pickup, b.pickup_done_time as second_pickup
  from p a
  left join p b on b.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code and b.rn = 2
  where a.rn = 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', f.first_pickup)::date as acq_month,
  count(*) as acquired_cx,
  sum(case when datediff(day, f.first_pickup, f.second_pickup) <= 30 then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% Repeat D30",
  sum(case when datediff(day, f.first_pickup, f.second_pickup) <= 60 then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% Repeat D60"
 from f
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where f.first_pickup::date <= current_date - 60
  and f.first_pickup >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: FTL Guardrail — FTL Trips per 1,000 Cx (SHOW vs DISABLE)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: FTL guardrail; FTL cannibalisation check; Test vs Control FTL trips.
 
 For new signups randomised into SHOW_PTL (17) or DISABLE_PTL (18) at signup, FTL trips per 1,000 consignors and % FTL-acquired in the 30 days after allocation, by signup month and arm. Guardrail: SHOW_PTL must not be lower than DISABLE_PTL.
 Formula: count(distinct FTL trip demand_id in [alloc_time, alloc_time + 30 days]) * 1000 / count(Cx in arm).
 Source: fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17 / 18, deleted = false = live), fact_leads (signup_date), fact_demands (load_type = 'FTL', trip_flag = 1); grain consignor.
 Cohort rule: only consignors allocated within 1 day of signup, because that split is randomised. Do not compare all SHOW vs all DISABLE consignors: SHOW also includes the hand-picked FTL retention base, which makes SHOW look better on FTL purely by selection.
 Filters: consigner_region of the signup lead (fact_leads: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3).
 Caveats: only cohorts allocated at least 30 days ago are shown.
SQL:
with arm as (
  select user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as is_show,
  min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as alloc_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 su as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  group by 1
 ),
 cohort as (
  select a.user_code, case when a.is_show = 1 then 'SHOW_PTL' else 'DISABLE_PTL' end as arm, a.alloc_time, s.signup_date
  from arm a
  join su s on s.consigner_user_code = a.user_code
  where datediff(day, s.signup_date, a.alloc_time::date) between 0 and 1 -- allocated at signup = randomised split
  [[and s.lead_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 ),
 ftl as (
  select c.user_code, count(distinct d.demand_id) as ftl_trips_30d
  from cohort c
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_demands d
  on d.consigner_user_code = c.user_code and d.load_type = 'FTL' and d.trip_flag = 1
  and d.demand_time >= c.alloc_time and d.demand_time < c.alloc_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', c.signup_date)::date as signup_month, c.arm,
  count(*) as cx,
  sum(coalesce(f.ftl_trips_30d,0))*1000.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "FTL Trips per 1,000 Cx (D30)",
  count(f.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% FTL Acquired (D30)"
 from cohort c
 left join ftl f on f.user_code = c.user_code
 where c.alloc_time::date <= current_date - 30
  and c.signup_date >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2
